parts.zh: W: 嗨，艾伦。抱歉没能早点给你回电话
M: 我父亲目前的经济状况让我意识到
W: 那我上个月和你谈过的那些工作机会呢？你有没有去那些公司了解一下
W: 听我说，艾伦，如果你一心想在艺术行业工作
M: 现在时间非常宝贵
W: 你现在所做的一切将决定你未来的选择
M: 我会考虑你说的话
M：说真的，这听起来是个很棒的主意

items.stem: What did the man want to discuss with the woman?

choices.text: Changing his major.
choices.zh: 更改他的专业。

choices.text: His family situation.
choices.zh: 他的家庭状况。

choices.text: Revising his graduation thesis.
choices.zh: 修改他的毕业论文。

choices.text: His passion for Art History.
choices.zh: 他对艺术史的热情。

items.stem: Why does the man want to give up Art History?

choices.text: He doesn't think it legitimate to depend on his father.
choices.zh: 他认为依赖父亲不合理。

choices.text: He thinks his financial situation has now changed.
choices.zh: 他认为他的经济状况现在已经改变了。

choices.text: He doesn't think it will provide him with a living.
choices.zh: 他认为艺术史无法让他谋生。

choices.text: He thinks it nourishes the financially secure only.
choices.zh: 他认为艺术史只能滋养经济富裕的人。

items.stem: What does the woman advise the man to do?

choices.text: Try his best to socialize and build a network in the art industry.
choices.zh: 尽力在艺术行业社交并建立人脉网络。

choices.text: Seek financially viable employment opportunities after graduation.
choices.zh: 毕业后寻找经济上可行的就业机会。

choices.text: Investigate all possible ways to become a celebrity in the art world.
choices.zh: 探究所有可能成为艺术界名人的途径。

choices.text: Strike a balance between intellectual pursuits and financial security.
choices.zh: 在智识追求与经济保障之间取得平衡。

items.stem: What does the man say he really lacks right now?

choices.text: Money.
choices.zh: 金钱。

choices.text: Time.
choices.zh: 时间。

choices.text: Determination.
choices.zh: 决心。

choices.text: Optimism.
choices.zh: 乐观态度。

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly talking about in the conversation?

choices.text: Their decision on investigating beef consumption.
choices.zh: 他们关于调查牛肉消费的决定。

choices.text: Their original ideas about the domestic market.
choices.zh: 他们对国内市场的最初想法。

choices.text: Their different approaches to a case study.
choices.zh: 他们对案例研究的不同方法。

choices.text: Their end-of-semester business projects.
choices.zh: 他们的学期末商业项目。

items.stem: What does the man say makes perfect sense?

choices.text: Expanding farmland out west.
choices.zh: 向西部扩张农田。

choices.text: Importing most of the beef.
choices.zh: 进口大部分牛肉。

choices.text: Raising cattle domestically.
choices.zh: 在国内饲养牛。

choices.text: Continuing to boost economic growth.
choices.zh: 继续促进经济增长。

items.stem: Why does the man believe he has a vast and continual market?

choices.text: Technical equipment.
choices.zh: 技术设备。

choices.text: Business consultancy.
choices.zh: 商业咨询。

choices.text: Beef.
choices.zh: 牛肉。

choices.text: Carwashing.
choices.zh: 洗车。

items.stem: Who would the man's imagined business cater to?

choices.text: Car owners of all walks of life.
choices.zh: 各行各业的车主。

choices.text: High-end customers in big cities.
choices.zh: 大城市的高端客户。

choices.text: Consumers craving for professional service.
choices.zh: 渴望专业服务的消费者。

choices.text: Well-off dealers seeking a profitable markup.
choices.zh: 寻求丰厚利润的富裕经销商。

items.stem: What do we learn from a new study about young children?

choices.text: Parents' talking with them during TV time raises their curiosity levels.
choices.zh: 父母在看电视期间与他们交谈会提高他们的好奇心水平。

choices.text: Their daily television exposure cuts parent-child conversation time.
choices.zh: 他们每天接触电视会减少亲子交流时间。

choices.text: The more TV they watch the poorer their progress in development.
choices.zh: 他们看电视越多,发展进步就越差。

choices.text: Their socioeconomic levels impact their academic achievement.
choices.zh: 他们的社会经济水平影响他们的学业成绩。

items.stem: What did Prachi Shah's study specifically focus on?

choices.text: Kids' enhanced learning.
choices.zh: 儿童的学习提升。

choices.text: Kids' curiosity levels.
choices.zh: 儿童的好奇心水平。

choices.text: Kids' reading and math.
choices.zh: 儿童的阅读和数学。

choices.text: Kids' behavioral development.
choices.zh: 儿童的行为发展。

items.stem: What does the passage say about excessive media exposure?

choices.text: It can hinder kids from getting on with their peers.
choices.zh: 它会妨碍儿童与同龄人相处。

choices.text: It can cut into kids' time on exploratory activities.
choices.zh: 它会占用儿童探索性活动的时间。

choices.text: It can arouse kids' interest in how people interact in real life.
choices.zh: 它会激发儿童对现实生活中人们如何互动的兴趣。

choices.text: It can widen the gap between kids from different economic statuses.
choices.zh: 它会扩大不同经济地位儿童之间的差距。

items.stem: What is the dark side of our inborn drive to acquire?

choices.text: Exerting ourselves too hard in order to attain our life's goals.
choices.zh: 为了实现人生目标而过度努力。

choices.text: Being possessed with a single thought of professional success.
choices.zh: 被追求职业成功的单一想法所占据。

choices.text: Trying every means to beat others in terms of personal aspirations.
choices.zh: 想尽一切办法在个人抱负方面击败他人。

choices.text: Being mindlessly driven to possess more and more material things.
choices.zh: 被盲目驱使去占有越来越多的物质。

items.stem: What might happen if we do not harness our inborn drive to acquire?

choices.text: We might isolate ourselves from our fellow beings.
choices.zh: 我们可能会将自己与同胞隔离开来。

choices.text: We might acquire an incorrect sense of well-being.
choices.zh: 我们可能会获得一种错误的幸福感。

choices.text: We might end up pursuing all the wrong things.
choices.zh: 我们可能最终会追求所有错误的东西。

choices.text: We might make a mess of our personal lives.
choices.zh: 我们可能会把个人生活搞得一团糟。

items.stem: What does the passage say about our intentional aspirational goals?

choices.text: They should be based on solid theoretical concepts.
choices.zh: 它们应该基于坚实的理论概念。

choices.text: They should take personal interests into account.
choices.zh: 它们应该考虑个人兴趣。

choices.text: They should include goals to help other people.
choices.zh: 它们应该包括帮助他人的目标。

choices.text: They should increase our sense of worthiness.
choices.zh: 它们应该增强我们的价值感。

items.stem: What will you end up doing without pursuing intentional aspirational goals?

choices.text: Drifting through life aimlessly.
choices.zh: 漫无目的地度过一生。

choices.text: Giving up the chance to fulfill yourself.
choices.zh: 放弃实现自我的机会。

choices.text: Abandoning all that life has to offer.
choices.zh: 放弃生活所提供的一切。

choices.text: Spoiling your character and integrity.
choices.zh: 毁坏你的品格和正直。

items.stem: What does the speaker recommend in this talk?

choices.text: Grade-raising ways and means.
choices.zh: 提高成绩的方式和方法。

choices.text: Pressure-alleviating exercise.
choices.zh: 缓解压力的锻炼。

choices.text: Revision-conducting approaches.
choices.zh: 进行复习的方法。

choices.text: Brain-boosting food and drink.
choices.zh: 增强大脑的食物和饮料。

items.stem: What does the speaker warn against coffee?

choices.text: Buying it from coffee shops.
choices.zh: 从咖啡店购买咖啡。

choices.text: Building up a tolerance of it.
choices.zh: 对咖啡产生耐受性。

choices.text: Drinking it after 2 pm.
choices.zh: 下午两点后饮用咖啡。

choices.text: Consuming it with sugar.
choices.zh: 与糖一起摄入咖啡。

items.stem: How can we get sufficient nutrients according to the speaker?

choices.text: By taking varied vitamin supplements.
choices.zh: 通过服用各种维生素补充剂。

choices.text: By consuming a rich variety of foods.
choices.zh: 通过摄入丰富多样的食物。

choices.text: By eating both oranges and frozen berries.
choices.zh: 通过食用橙子和冷冻浆果。

choices.text: By getting components packaged in tablets.
choices.zh: 通过获取包装在药片中的成分。

items.stem: What is the worrying trend the late Swedish academic has identified?

choices.text: Many people across advanced economies think the world is going from bad to worse.
choices.zh: 发达经济体中的许多人认为世界正在每况愈下。

choices.text: The news focuses on reporting catastrophes that occur across the world.
choices.zh: 新闻侧重于报道世界各地发生的灾难。

choices.text: A significant part of the world is experiencing another great recession.
choices.zh: 世界上很大一部分地区正在经历另一次大衰退。

choices.text: Many people have no idea of those living under miserable conditions.
choices.zh: 许多人不了解那些生活在悲惨境况下的人。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about globalization?

choices.text: It has experienced ups and downs like any other historical trend.
choices.zh: 它像任何其他历史趋势一样经历了起伏。

choices.text: It is hailed as a miracle by both economists and ordinary people.
choices.zh: 经济学家和普通人都将其誉为奇迹。

choices.text: It is the only way for all countries to share economic prosperity.
choices.zh: 这是所有国家共享经济繁荣的唯一途径。

choices.text: It has given more and more countries a rare chance to thrive.
choices.zh: 它给越来越多的国家提供了难得的繁荣机会。

items.stem: What do we learn about half of the global population?

choices.text: Their fortunes may take a downturn.
choices.zh: 他们的命运可能会走下坡路。

choices.text: They can be classified as middle class.
choices.zh: 他们可以归类为中产阶级。

choices.text: Their living standards have been deteriorating.
choices.zh: 他们的生活水平一直在恶化。

choices.text: They are experiencing a radical transformation.
choices.zh: 他们正在经历一场彻底的转变。

items.stem: What question does the speaker try to answer in this talk?

choices.text: Why smells can activate emotional memories.
choices.zh: 为什么气味能激活情感记忆。

choices.text: How powerful the sense of smell can become.
choices.zh: 嗅觉能变得多么强大。

choices.text: How scent particles revive memories forgotten.
choices.zh: 气味粒子如何唤醒被遗忘的记忆。

choices.text: Why the scent of bread has a strong mental impact.
choices.zh: 为什么面包的气味具有强烈的心理影响。

items.stem: What is said to result in an intimate connection between emotions, memories and scents?

choices.text: The brain cells' processing of memories experienced as strongly emotional.
choices.zh: 脑细胞对被体验为强烈情感的记忆的处理。

choices.text: The activation of the brain's emotion processing area by chemical particles.
choices.zh: 化学粒子对大脑情感处理区域的激活。

choices.text: The interaction between chemical particles and the brain cells responsible for smell.
choices.zh: 化学粒子与负责嗅觉的脑细胞之间的相互作用。

choices.text: The sensations of scents going directly to the brain's emotional and memory centers.
choices.zh: 气味的感觉直接进入大脑的情感和记忆中枢。

items.stem: What does the brain use to give meaning to information and find a memory?

choices.text: Imagination.
choices.zh: 想象。

choices.text: Association.
choices.zh: 联想。

choices.text: Experience.
choices.zh: 经验。

choices.text: Context.
choices.zh: 语境。

items.stem: What drawback do memories of scents share with other memories?

choices.text: Inaccuracy and alterability.
choices.zh: 不准确性和可改变性。

choices.text: Susceptibility to polar interpretations.
choices.zh: 易受极端解释的影响。

choices.text: Being personal and individualistic.
choices.zh: 具有个人性和个体性。

choices.text: Being dependent on relevant scenarios.
choices.zh: 依赖于相关情境。
